manifest.description: FXL process audit stage A as recorded readings: for each required issue unit of a checkpoint's define stage, Jev scores each criterion citing it (its statement, aspects and examples) on three levels (other behaviour, concerns it, states it). Per-unit and per-criterion level probabilities and every raw Jev call are kept in the Assessment's raw payloads; the observations only count and average them. No cut-off is applied: FXL's own review found its audit cut-offs uncalibrated. Not applicable without a define stage.

manifest.description: FXL process audit stage B as recorded readings: for each criterion of a checkpoint's sealed definition, Jev scores each of the builder's final mapped tests (source and one hop of helpers, from the retained test files) on three levels (never runs the situation, runs it but would still pass, would fail if the behaviour were wrong). A test with no real assertion, or marked skipped, is held to level 1 as FXL does. Per-criterion and per-test probabilities and every raw Jev call are kept in the Assessment's raw payloads; the observations only count and average them. No cut-off is applied. Not applicable without a define stage.
